title: Design System: AI Web Vulnerability Scanner

mono.purpose: URLs, code, and AI classification output.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for scan initiation and confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #7c3aed, #a855f7); color: #ffffff; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.35); }

components.css: .ds-card { background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px solid #2a2a2a; border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; transition: all 250ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #a855f7; transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.25); } .ds-card-title { color: #ffffff; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-desc { color: #a3a3a3; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; }

narrative.overview: The Sentinel's Ledger represents a design philosophy where security assessment is treated with the gravity and precision of a master record. It priorities readability and trust through refined darkness.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary 'Electric Amethyst' color should be used on ≤10% of any given screen.

rules.name: The Clarity Rule
rules.body: Never use a font size smaller than 12px for critical security data.

dos: Do use Geist Mono for all technical strings.
Do maintain a minimum padding of 24px in major containers.
Do use OKLCH for dynamic color tints.
donts: Don't use neon-green or 'Matrix' style fonts.
Don't use side-stripe borders as color accents.
